chapter: Kirby again, Garland gigs and later recordings
title: Recording with Princess White and with a Swedish band
summary: He did one more side with Princess White and added solos to tapes from a Swedish band that covered his 'Saratoga Shout'.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Well, you came out one more time and did some more records with me. One more side with Princess White.
Yeah. I guess they were the worst...
Because we had two altos on that, you and George Taitt.
Yeah, that really nailed the coffin down.
But then you had another admirer from Sweden, Gusta(?) Hegler(?), who was involved with a Swedish band called Kostbandet(?). And he asked you to do some recording.
Yeah. He sent some tapes over, some numbers that his band had recorded, and they had some open spaces, I think, and he wanted me to play my solos.
Well, they also did your tune.
Yeah, but I didn't know they were going to do that, you know? You know, they (?) write my tune.

"Saratoga Shout." And it was quite an experience for me to playing a horn with some earphones up to my ears, listening at a band playing. You know, I just couldn't get with that. Because I never... I mean, I'm not

used to no band playing in my ears like that. I'll be listening to the band and forgetting what I'm supposed to be playing! But it wasn't too bad, you know, for an experimental thing. I don't think it sounded too bad.
